messages.subject: scan additional interacting QTLs by addqtl
parts:
Hi Karl and other community members,

I have a question about threshold for scanning additional interacting QTLs. The code below is the sample code from the r/qtl book, which tries to search for additional QTL interacting with Q4

> out.aq <- addqtl(hyper, qtl=rqtl, formula=y~Q1+Q2+Q3*Q4)
> out.aqi <- addqtl(hyper, qtl=rqtl, formula=y~Q1+Q2+Q3*Q4+Q4*Q5)

Should the threshold for :out.aqi - out.aq"  be the "int" threshold from scantwo permutation tests? Or threshold for "out.aqi" be the "fv1" from scantwo permutation tests? 

Thanks!

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] scan additional interacting QTLs by addqtl
parts:
fv1, since the difference includes both the interaction and a main effect.

karl
